note: Milestone 14: a race's bonuses are mixed from three layers, its creature's group (creatures.json `group`), its creature and its culture (families.json), one bonus each (src/identity.gd). A bonus is {text, effects, alt?, kind?, price_points?}: effects in the research shape (D-111, src/sim/tech.gd); when a later layer's bonus is the same kind as an earlier one (the same scope and stat, or the same `kind`), it takes its `alt`. Unit stat effects (add to hp, attack, armour, range, speed, bonus.*, or pct of speed, cost, train_time) are applied by pricing.gd before the price, and the bonus's `price_points` go on every unit it reaches (cost is the balancer); the rest (buildings, gathering, carry, sight, ...) by the sim at setup. A bonus with no effects says something the race already has from elsewhere (movement classes).

bonuses.text: Farms in water: rice paddies in the shallows

movement.note: How the tech tree page says how a race's units move (the class each unit gets from rules.movement).
